name: Cannonade
description: Cannon blocks sit on top of marble boxes. Tap any box next to a Cannon and it fires a stored box into the empty slot — keeping the grid alive while slowly shrinking. When the shared ammo runs dry, the Cannons crumble and reveal the marble boxes underneath.
howToPlay: Tap the coloured boxes on either side of the grey Cannon blocks. Each tap triggers a cannon fire — watch the muzzle flash and a new box pop into place. After enough fires the Cannons crumble and reveal normal boxes underneath. Keep tapping until every marble is sorted!
